abstract: High-molecular-weight glycopeptides synthesised by teratocarcinoma OTT6050 bear the binding site for Griffonia simplicifolia agglutinin I and are recognised by antibodies in the sera of patients with ovarian germ cell tumors. Digestion of the glycopeptides with endo-beta-D-galactosidase C abolished the lectin binding activity and the antigenic activity. Since the product of the enzymic digestion is alpha-D-Gal-(1----3)-D-Gal, it is concluded that the disaccharide structure is involved in the lectin binding site and the antigenic site.
abstract_ja: 奇形癌OTT6050が合成する高分子量糖ペプチドは、Griffonia simplicifolia凝集素Iの結合部位を有し、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の血清中の抗体によって認識される。糖ペプチドをendo-β-D-ガラクトシダーゼCで消化すると、レクチン結合活性と抗原活性は消失した。消化産物はα-D-Gal-(1→3)-D-Galであるため、二糖構造がレクチン結合部位および抗原部位に関与すると結論した。
